test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: The central theme of the passage is ___________.

options.text: one should enjoy beauty in youth
beauty is indefinable but can be felt and experienced
physical health is more important than beauty

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage primarily discusses the idea that beauty is subjective and cannot be strictly defined.
 
• It emphasizes that beauty is something to be felt and experienced rather than concretely described.
 
• The reference to the faceless painting in Warsaw further illustrates that beauty is open to interpretation.
 
• The passage also compares beauty to love, stating that both are indefinable yet desirable.

Therefore, the central theme of the passage is best represented by **Option 2: Beauty is indefinable but can be felt and experienced.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "One should enjoy beauty in youth" – This is not the central theme, as the passage does not discuss beauty in the context of age.
 
• **Option 3:** "Physical health is more important than beauty" – The passage does not focus on health versus beauty.
 
• **Option 4:** "Beautiful women can inspire others" – While beauty is discussed, it is not limited to women or inspiration.
